method.reason: An eight-pixel inset excludes compression bleed from the header progress line and the legend boundary.
method.exactMotion: SHA-256 of every decoded grayscale crop, with adjacent equality and unchanged runs.
method.oneSecondMotion: Mean absolute grayscale difference (0–255) at one-second sample intervals; changedPixelFraction counts pixels differing by at least 3 gray levels.
method.limits: Pixel changes can include lines, labels or effects inside the court. This measures actual raster motion but does not replace reviewing whether the demonstrated action is understandable.
